irembo-training.summary: Iga gukoresha Irembo nta nkomyi: kumenya gushaka serivisi ikwiye, kuzuza ubusabe, kwishyura fagitire, no gukurikirana ibisubizo. Amahugurwa atangwa kuri interineti cyangwa ku biro byacu, kandi ikiguzi cyishyurwa buri kwezi.
irembo-training.via: Kuri interineti cyangwa ku biro byacu

irembo-training.timeShort: Kuri interineti cyangwa ku biro byacu

who.title: Abafite ibiro by'ikoranabuhanga n'abafasha abandi
who.body: Abasabira serivisi abakiriya.

who.title: Abakozi bo mu biro
who.body: Abasabira serivisi ikigo cyangwa kompanyi bakorera.

who.title: Abantu ku giti cyabo
who.body: Abifuza kujya bikorera serivisi zose ubwabo.

requirements: Imeli cyangwa numero ya terefone yo gukoresha kuri konte yawe ya Irembo

steps.title: Wiyandikisha guhugurwa
steps.body: Tubwire abazitabira n'aho mwifuza guhugurirwa: kuri interineti cyangwa ku biro byacu.

steps.title: Tugena ingengabihe y'amahugurwa
steps.body: Umuhuguzi wawe agena nawe amatariki n'amasaha binyuze kuri WhatsApp.

steps.title: Wishyura ikiguzi cyacu
steps.body: Ishyura ukoresheje MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money. Nta mafaranga ya leta asabwa.

steps.title: Wiga witoza mu bikorwa
steps.body: Kwiga mukora ku ngero zifatika z'ubucuruzi, ku muvuduko ukubereye, no kubona umwanya uhagije wo kubaza ibibazo.

irembo-training.officialNote: Nta mafaranga ya leta asabwa. Iyi ni serivisi itangwa na Inzira.
purposes: Aho ari ho hose bimbereye kimwe
